proposals.evidence: DEDR3735 explicitly gives Konda negi good, negikan a good man and negeṇḍ good/well. Survey negika good fits this same-language adjective with its ending retained. The article’s Indo-Aryan convergence warning remains relevant, but its explicitly loaned Parji niko/Gondi nikkā forms are not included. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
